lines.3: 「I wondered whether introducing everyone without warning was wise, but I never expected it to go this well.」
lines.4: 「If only the cooking had gone as well.」
lines.5: 「That was a vicious jab. I am sensitive about it.」
lines.6: Otome had begun practicing her cooking that very day.
lines.7: But she failed, and dinner ended up being rice balls.
lines.8: 「Yes... The cooking was a failure, but the rice balls taste good. Do they not?」
lines.9: 「Three meals of rice balls is a little...」
lines.12: 「Hmm. You are in a foul mood. Is it because I revealed to the Princess that we live together?」
lines.13: 「She would have discovered it sooner or later. In that case, telling her now was unquestionably better. Trust the judgment of your older sister.」
lines.15: 「You are now in the same executive group as Erika Kiriya. What comes of it will depend on your own ability.」
lines.16: 「Does that mean you were supporting me?」
lines.17: 「That is part of it, but the staff shortage was real. I will not hold it over you.」
lines.18: 「So you approve of boys and girls dating?」
lines.19: 「I see no problem as long as they behave with moderation.」
lines.20: 「You said you'd never had any experience with that sort of thing, right?」
lines.22: Otome licked a grain of rice from her finger.
lines.23: 「I have never dated, but I have received many love letters.」
lines.26: Well, she did seem like the type.
